what: ISIE published 2019 results as per-bureau spreadsheets under a filebases/ tree.
naming: pv-auto-bv = proces-verbal, automatique, bureau de vote -- per polling bureau, finer than the delegation PDFs and far finer than the 33 constituencies the repo holds for 2019.
live_state: 404 on isie.tn; the whole pre-2020 uploads tree is gone.
found_by: user, not by this session's searching
correction: The pv-auto-bv-presidentielles-tour2 workbooks are the DECEMBER 2014 presidential runoff, not 2019: the candidate columns read محمد الباجي القايد السبسي and محمد المنصف المرزوقي (Beji Caid Essebsi, Moncef Marzouki). The 2019 runoff was Saied against Karoui. The 20191026093137 in the URL is Wayback's capture date, not the election's.

note: The tree is browsable in the archive; enumerate rather than guess names -- ISIE's ASCII spellings differ from data/delegations_ins.csv (Tozeur/Tameghza matches exactly, but 'Cite Ettadhamen' appears as Ariana/Ettadhamen).
Sibling trees almost certainly exist; tools/fetch_2019_bureau.py --survey enumerates them from the CDX index rather than assuming.

detail: Unreachable from the session that recorded this. Not a policy denial -- the 403 cleared when the environment was widened to Full -- and not the client: curl, Python and real Chromium through the same proxy all get ECONNRESET at ~11s, while archive.org and isie.tn return 200 through that same browser. A session reads its network configuration once at startup, so a new session is required.
resolved: web.archive.org became reachable on 2026-09-13 and both confirmed URLs downloaded as valid xlsx (23112 and 16333 bytes).

note: Counts are archived URLs, not distinct bureaux; the first survey hit the 50000-row cap so treat these as lower bounds until paginated.

formats.pv-auto-bv-presidentielles-tour2: xlsx, tabulated, one row per bureau

columns: 11-digit bureau code, centre name, votes per candidate, row total
